start_body: Or open one. EchoPlay finds every audio track in ShadowPlay, NVIDIA App and OBS recordings.
drop_note: The other clips in its folder join the playlist.
subtitle_delay_tip: Shows the subtitles earlier or later, for when they come before or after the words. For this clip only.
audio_delay_tip: Plays the sound earlier or later than the picture, for when voices and lips are out of step. For this clip only.
picture_tip: How sharply the picture is scaled to the window. Auto steps down when the computer cannot keep up and back up when it can.
end_desc: Next plays the following clip in the folder.
loudness_desc: Lifts quiet voices and tames loud explosions in every clip.
strength_desc: Stronger lifts quiet parts more, and can pump in loud scenes.
device_desc: Where EchoPlay plays sound. Default follows Windows.
maxvol_desc: The highest level the volume slider and arrow keys reach.
tracks_title: Tracks on when a clip opens
tracks_desc: The mixer can start from your last clip or with every track on.
seek_desc: How far the left and right arrows jump.
speedstep_desc: How much the S and D keys change the speed.
fixed_desc: The speed the G key switches to.
resume_title: Reopening a clip you left partway
resume_desc: Ask each time, always continue, or always start over.
clickpause_title: A click on the video pauses
clickpause_desc: A double click is full screen either way.
default_desc: Only you can choose it in Windows: this opens EchoPlay's page in Default apps, where you pick it for the file types you want.
quality_desc: Auto starts at Normal and moves a step when frames drop. Ultra needs a strong graphics card.
theme_desc: Follow Windows, or pick one. Controls over the video stay dark.
accent_desc: Used for the progress bar, switches and the mixer. Pick one, or any color.
accent_windows_desc: Uses the color picked in Windows (Personalization > Colors) and follows it when it changes.
bar_desc: A floating island, or edge to edge.
font_desc: One of ours, or your own font file.
font_bad: That file is not a font.
glass_desc: How much of the video shows through the panels.
themefile_desc: Colors, corners, blur and fonts live in one file. Edit it to make EchoPlay yours.
language_desc: Adding a language takes one file in the lang folder.
shortcuts_desc: Click a key to change it.
action_ab_loop: Loop a part: start, end, off
action_save_cut: Save the A-B part with this mix
cut_needs_loop: Set the part's start and end with L first
cut_busy: A part is already being saved
download_progress_close: %1 of %2 MB. Installs when you close EchoPlay.
download_progress: %1 of %2 MB. EchoPlay restarts when it is ready.
update_failed: The update could not be installed
update_failed_try: Try again, or get it from the releases page.
privacy_line: Checks GitHub for a new version when EchoPlay starts. Sends nothing else.
hint_body: Turn the game or your mic up and down here while it plays. Ctrl+1 and Ctrl+2 switch them too.
no_sound_body: This clip is playing without sound.
loop_start: Loop starts at %1. Press again for its end.
shot_failed: The screenshot could not be saved
frame_copy_failed: The frame could not be copied
trash_title: Move this clip to the Recycle Bin?
trash_failed: It could not be deleted. Another program may be using it.
error_format_body: It has no video or audio EchoPlay can read. It may still be recording, or it was cut off while saving.
error_load_body: EchoPlay could not read it. It may have been moved or deleted, or another program may be holding it.
error_empty_body: It opened, but no video or audio came out of it. It may be damaged.
error_audio_title: The sound device could not start
error_audio_body: The file itself may be fine. Check that the device is connected, or pick another one in Settings.
error_video_body: The file itself may be fine. Updating the graphics driver usually helps.
error_other_title: Something went wrong with this file
error_other_body: Open it again. If it keeps happening, the details below help find out why.
